Lower Bound In this section, we provide lower bounds for both distributed K-armed and distributed linear bandits. Recall that these bounds feature the sum of a communication cost term and a bandit cost term. For each setting, the proof shows that there exist problem instances forcing either term in the bound. Hence, the overall lower bound is asymptotic to the sum of these two terms. We start with the lower bound for K-armed bandits, which is a combination of the lower bound construction for the K- armed bandits with N T observed losses (Seldin et al., 2014) and the one in Yi and Vojnovic (2023). The full proof is deferred to Appendix E.
